**Kolin Construction** (*Kolin İnşaat Turizm Sanayi ve Ticaret A.Ş.*) is one of Turkey’s major construction and industrial companies. Founded in **1977** and headquartered in **Ankara, Turkey**, the company serves as a flagship business of **Koloğlu Holding**.

## Business Activities

Kolin Construction operates primarily in large-scale construction, infrastructure, and engineering projects. Its areas of expertise include:

* Highways and road infrastructure
* Bridges and viaducts
* Tunnels
* Railways and metro systems
* Airports
* Ports and marine infrastructure
* Dams and hydroelectric power plants
* Energy infrastructure
* Industrial and mining projects

The company has participated in numerous major infrastructure developments in Turkey and abroad and has regularly appeared in international contractor rankings published by **Engineering News-Record (ENR)**.

## Major Projects

Kolin Construction has been involved in several large-scale and strategically important projects. One of its most notable developments is its participation in the construction of **Istanbul Airport**, one of the largest aviation infrastructure projects in the world.

Beyond transportation infrastructure, the company is active in projects involving power generation, water infrastructure, ports, industrial facilities, and other complex engineering works.

## Other Business Sectors

Through its broader corporate group, Kolin is also involved in several industries outside traditional construction, including:

* Energy and power generation
* Mining
* Port operations
* Shipyards and maritime services
* Tourism
* Trade and commercial activities

## International Presence

Kolin Construction maintains an international presence and has undertaken projects across **Europe, Asia, the Middle East, and Africa**.

Its international operations have included countries such as:

* Azerbaijan
* Libya
* Uganda
* Poland
* Romania
* Oman
* Saudi Arabia
* Kuwait

The company has established representative offices and project operations in several of these markets to support its international engineering and construction activities.

## Company Scale

Kolin Construction is considered one of the prominent Turkish contractors operating internationally. Its annual turnover has been reported in the range of approximately **USD 1.5–2 billion**, reflecting the scale of its infrastructure, energy, and industrial projects.

## Summary

With several decades of experience, Kolin Construction has developed capabilities in managing complex, large-scale infrastructure and engineering projects. Its portfolio covers transportation, energy, industrial construction, and public infrastructure, with operations extending from Turkey to multiple international markets.

entrees.resume: Momentum is a telecommunications company founded in 2001 that provides cloud-based communication solutions for businesses, specializing in cloud voice services, managed networks, SD-WAN solutions, and Microsoft Teams Phone integration. We gained access to a diagnostic and provisioning tool used by Momentum through a compromised Multi-Service Operator (MSO). We successfully accessed user data for every MSO, exposing personally identifiable information (PII) for over 7.5 million users. They didn't notice the prolonged access or the customer data dump for a while, but when we started deleting modems they noticed. They kept burning access and we gained it back, they'd burn it again. We have caused widespread outages (https://www.abc4.com/news/wasatch-front/eagle-mountain-internet-outage-cyberattack/). We now have had over 100,000 packages successfully deleted. That's 100,000+ people without internet service right now. Families, businesses, students all cut off from the digital world. This is the direct result of their negligence and failure to secure their systems. These services can be restored immediately with the click of a button on our tool but you must reach out. Click "View Affected MSOs" below to see the full list of compromised providers. Momentum management should contact us to discuss resolution. Affected MSOs can also contact us to have their users' data deleted from our database.

entrees.titre: In Frankreich wurden Kühlanlagen manipuliert – geht das auch bei uns?
entrees.resume:
In der Nacht von Sonntag auf Montag (11./12. Oktober) wurden in Frankreich die Kühlanlagen diverser Einzelhandelsketten so manipuliert, dass das Gefriergut aufgeheizt und damit unbrauchbar gemacht wurde. Meine erste Reaktion drauf war, dass da wohl jemand in die Netze eingestiegen war, und von innen heraus die ICS-Komponenten umkonfiguriert hat.

Weil so unvorsichtig, diese Systeme offen ins Internet zu hängen, sollten diese Firmen ja doch nicht gewesen sein.

Ich habe schon oft gescherzt, dass „sollte“ das gefährlichste Wort in der Cybersecurity ist. Mein Chef formuliert das leicht anders, nämlich „Assumptions are the mother of all f*ckups.“. Die Grundaussage ist die gleiche: die Annahme, dass alle (inkl. man selbst) mitgedacht haben und vernünftig handeln, ist leider oft falsch.

De manière générale l'exposition d'une interface de gestion sur Internet est contraire aux bonnes pratiques.

Auf Deutsch: Managementinterfaces gehören nicht offen ins Internet.

entrees.titre: NCSC-2026-0478 [1.00] [M/H] Kwetsbaarheden verholpen in N-able N-central
entrees.resume:
N-able heeft meerdere kwetsbaarheden verholpen in N-able N-central. Deze kwetsbaarheden treffen versies ouder dan 2026.4.1.26. Er meerdere kwetsbaarheden met betrekking tot XML External Entity (XXE), waardoor de verwerking van XML-data mogelijk op ongewenste wijze kan worden beïnvloed. Daarnaast zijn er kwetsbaarheden in de vorm van OGNL Injection en Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS), waarbij kwaadaardige code kan worden geïnjecteerd en uitgevoerd binnen de webinterface, waaronder in de context van een administrator.

Verder zijn er meerdere kwetsbaarheden die lokale privilege-escalatie mogelijk maken, waaronder via een onjuist beveiligde syslog-ng-configuratie en onveilige Inter-Process Communication (IPC)-kanalen. Ook is er sprake van een Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)-kwetsbaarheid via de validatie van schema-informatie bij het importeren van services. Ten slotte is een kwetsbaarheid vastgesteld in de verwerking van bestandspaden bij het uploaden naar de file repository, waarbij path traversal kan leiden tot Remote Code Execution (RCE).

18. November 2026

Beschreibung

In NGINX Plus und NGINX Open Source existieren mehrere Sicherheitslücken in den Modulen ngx_http_v2_module (HTTP/2), ngx_http_v3_module (HTTP/3) und ngx_mail_proxy_module (Mail-Proxy). Es handelt sich um Use-after-free-Schwachstellen sowie einen Heap-Buffer-Overflow, deren Ausnutzung zum Absturz von Worker-Prozessen und unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen zur Ausführung von beliebigem Code führen kann. F5 bewertet die Schwachstellen nach CVSS v4.0 als kritisch.

CVE-Nummer(n): CVE-2026-123007, CVE-2026-121810, CVE-2026-123633, CVE-2026-113425

CVSS Base Score: jeweils 8.1 (CVSS v3.1) bzw. 9.2 (CVSS v4.0)

Auswirkungen

Durch Ausnutzen der Schwachstellen können Angreifer:innen aus der Ferne NGINX-Worker-Prozesse zum Absturz bringen (Denial-of-Service) oder deren Speicher korrumpieren. Auf Systemen, auf denen Address Space Layout Randomization (ASLR) deaktiviert ist oder ASLR umgangen werden kann, ist laut F5 zudem die Ausführung von beliebigem Code möglich.

entrees.titre: NCSC-2026-0498 [1.00] [M/H] Kwetsbaarheden verholpen in Oracle Communications
entrees.resume: Oracle heeft kwetsbaarheden verholpen in onder andere Oracle Communications Unified Assurance, Oracle Communications Billing and Revenue Management, Oracle Primavera Unifier, en Oracle Java SE. Daarnaast zijn fixes uitgebracht voor Ruby-componenten in Oracle Communication producten zoals Net::IMAP, Mail, Nokogiri, rubyzip en MessagePack, Node.js, OpenSSL, Curl, Libgcrypt, Libexpat, Puma, Containerd, Faraday, go-git, PCRE2, Apache Tomcat, Apache HTTP Server, Perl DBI, nghttp2, en andere open source libraries en tools. De kwetsbaarheden omvatten diverse typen beveiligingsproblemen zoals incorrecte cryptografische berekeningen, onvoldoende toegangsbeperkingen, heap buffer overflows, use-after-free fouten, denial-of-service door crashes of resource leaks, command injection, path traversal, memory corruptie, integer overflows, en onjuiste validatie van input. Aanvallers kunnen deze kwetsbaarheden misbruiken om onder meer ongeautoriseerde toegang te verkrijgen, gevoelige informatie te lekken, data te wijzigen, systemen te laten crashen, denial-of-service te veroorzaken, of in sommige gevallen volledige systeemcompromittering te bereiken. Sommige kwetsbaarheden vereisen authentificatie, andere kunnen door onbevoegde netwerkaanvallers worden geëxploiteerd. Er zijn ook kwetsbaarheden die specifiek impact hebben op bepaalde configuraties of functies, zoals persistent connections in Puma of OAuth token refresh in RabbitMQ.
